query:
SELECT
            a.id as "id",
            COALESCE(a.full_name, a.label) AS "full_name?",
            jsonb_build_object('label', r.label, 'id', r.id) AS "room: RoomEmbed"
        FROM
            accounts_people a
            LEFT JOIN res_leases l ON a.id = l.tenant_id
            LEFT JOIN res_rooms r ON l.room_id = r.id WHERE TRUE  AND r.label IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.label DESC LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2
